description: This Java class defines a command handler for creating collateral products within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, uses dependency injection for the CollateralManagementWritePlatformService, and processes create commands within a transactional context.

classes.name: CreateCollateralProductCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the creation of collateral products via commands, integrating with the service layer to persist data.

methods.name: CreateCollateralProductCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the service for collateral management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the create collateral product command within a transactional context by delegating to the service layer.
